commits_behind.author: Åsmund Collin
commits_behind.subject: fix: re-sort macros when the sort button is pressed (#1808)
commits_behind.message: change_sort scheduled reload_macros, but reload_macros returns early unless macros_dirty is set, so the button only flipped its icon. The list is now marked dirty before the reload so it is rebuilt in the new order.

commits_behind.author: Åsmund Collin
commits_behind.subject: fix: keep mirrored bed mesh when only x is inverted (#1807)
commits_behind.message: With only invert_x set, the mirrored matrix was overwritten by the else branch of the following invert_y check, while the X axis labels stayed swapped, so the map and labels disagreed. Making the Y check an elif restores the separate none, X-only and Y-only cases; both axes are still handled as a 180 degree rotation.

commits_behind.author: Åsmund Collin
commits_behind.subject: fix: strip only the root prefix from gcode file paths (#1806)
commits_behind.message:
* fix: strip only the root prefix from gcode file paths

File paths were built with replace("gcodes/", ""), which removed every occurrence, so files in folders such as old_gcodes/ or a subfolder named gcodes got paths pointing to the wrong file for print and delete. Only the leading root prefix is now removed. The file-change callback also stripped a leading gcodes/ from root-relative paths to undo its own mutation of the shared file cache; it now builds a copy instead, and delete_from_list compares root-relative paths so a file under a gcodes/ subfolder is no longer confused with a root file.

* fix: strip the gcodes root only when the path starts with it

Replace the unconditional slices with strip_gcodes_root, which leaves a path unchanged if it does not start with gcodes/ instead of cutting the first seven characters of a real name.

commits_behind.author: Åsmund Collin
commits_behind.subject: fix: order tools by extruder number (#1805)
commits_behind.message:
* fix: order tools by extruder number

Tools were sorted as text, so extruder10 came before extruder2. The list index is used as the tool number for T and M104 T, so with 11 or more extruders the wrong tool was selected or heated. Tools are now sorted by their numeric suffix, with extruder steppers kept after all extruders as before.

* fix: share the natural sort key with the temperature panels

Move the tool sort key to ks_includes.functions as natural_sort_key and use it for the device rows in the main menu and temperature panels, so extruder10 is no longer listed above extruder2. Extruder steppers still sort after all extruders.

commits_behind.author: Åsmund Collin
commits_behind.subject: fix: do not echo printer pin state back as SET_PIN (#1804)
commits_behind.message: Updating an on/off pin switch from printer state fired its notify::active handler, so every external pin change was sent back as a new SET_PIN. A macro that pulses a pin could therefore have its VALUE=1 replayed after it finished, leaving the pin on. The handler is now blocked while the switch follows the printer state.

commits_behind.author: Åsmund Collin
commits_behind.subject: fix: keep numeric labels at a constant width (#1803)
commits_behind.message: Temperatures and percentages changed width when crossing 1/2/3 digits, shifting the main menu heater column, the titlebar and job status values. ASCII-space padding did not help because a space is narrower than a digit in proportional fonts. Pad with U+2007 FIGURE SPACE instead.

commits_behind.author: SAZA-1118
commits_behind.subject: settings: fix language selection buttons passing the display label (#1799)
commits_behind.message:
The "button" option type in ScreenPanel.add_option() invokes callbacks
with option["name"] (the translated display label). For the language
menu that label is e.g. "简体中文 (zh_CN)", which
Screen.change_language() forwards to install_language(); it cannot be
matched against lang_list, so the selection silently falls back to
English and switching the UI language from the settings panel never
works.

Wrap the callback so it passes the language code (the dict key)
instead of relying on the display name. The default argument binds the
loop variable per iteration.

commits_behind.author: umeiko
commits_behind.subject: refactor(network): use async libnm with sdbus fallback (#1789)
commits_behind.message:
* refactor(network): use async libnm with sdbus fallback

Use libnm's object cache and asynchronous callbacks on the GTK main context
to keep network discovery and refresh responsive. Track scan completion and
connection activation for busy indicators and connected labels, support
hidden SSIDs, and preserve saved profile settings during credential updates.

Retain the async sdbus implementation from alfrix's PR #1791 as an automatic
or explicitly selected compatibility backend. Discover the new GI dependency
through modern and legacy Moonraker updater configurations, and report
fallback availability and deprecation during installation.

Include backend, GTK and fallback selection regression coverage, migration
documentation, profiling captures and the device demonstration.

Fixes #1788.
